# Determinacy up to likeness / 相同之下的确定

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`determinacy-up-to-likeness` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](determinacy-up-to-likeness.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Determinacy is the named case of determinacy up to likeness, and the laws on how configurations relate hold up to likeness, including when a description carries a law; an intervention on one of alike configurations, an unregistered past and an unregistered description need equality.
>
> 确定是相同之下的确定的命名情形，关于配置如何相关的律在相同之下成立，包括描述何时承载规律；对相同者之一的干预、未登记的过去与未登记的描述需要相等。

## Laws / 规律

1. Determinacy is determinacy up to likeness where the claims name the configurations, so each theorem stated with determinacy is the named instance of one stated up to likeness.<br>主张命名配置时，确定就是相同之下的确定，所以每个以确定陈述的定理都是一个在相同之下陈述者的命名实例。 (`Becoming.determined_iff_named`, `Becoming.alike_configurations`)
2. Going alike through likeness is determinacy up to likeness, and runs alike stay alike; the counterparts stated with equality are their named instances.<br>经相同而同行就是相同之下的确定，相同的运行保持相同；以相等陈述的对应者是其命名实例。 (`Becoming.GoesAlike`, `Becoming.goesAlike_iff`, `Becoming.DeterminedAt.stays_alike`, `Becoming.goAlike_id_iff`, `Becoming.GoAlike.runs_agree`)
3. What the step does not depend on is re-absorbed up to likeness; with the noise forgotten, the standard model is determined up to likeness exactly where the noise makes no difference up to likeness.<br>一步不依赖的在相同之下被重新吸收；遗忘噪声后，标准模型恰在噪声在相同之下无差别时在相同之下确定。 (`Becoming.DependsOnlyOnAlike`, `Becoming.DependsOnlyOnAlike.reabsorbed`, `Becoming.forget_inputs_determinedAt_iff`)
4. A move taken is fixed up to likeness and one occasion stands for its class; a move taken at no configuration alike to the one named is not fixed, for outcomes that differ in a claim, through an intervention on a whole likeness class.<br>所取的动作在相同之下固定，一次代表其类；在与所命名者相同的配置处从未取的动作，对在一个主张上不同的结果不被固定，经对整个相同类的干预。 (`Becoming.Run.FixesAlike`, `Becoming.Run.fixesAlike_of_takes`, `Becoming.Run.generalizesAlike`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixesAlike_of_untaken`, `Becoming.retargetAlike`, `Becoming.retargetAlike_determinedAt`)
5. Where the frame is determined up to likeness and no configuration of a run is alike to an earlier one, at each configuration the run passes the record fixes up to likeness no move other than the one taken there, for outcomes that differ in a claim.<br>框架在相同之下确定、运行中没有配置与先前的相同时，在运行经过的每个配置处，记录在相同之下不固定那里所取动作以外的任何动作，对在一个主张上不同的结果。 (`Becoming.Run.not_fixesAlike_other_of_new`, `Becoming.Run.new_of_newAlike`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixes_other_of_new`)
6. A description carries a law up to likeness exactly where some equivalence on descriptions relates only descriptions realizing the same claims and takes configurations whose descriptions it relates, by one move, to configurations whose descriptions it relates; the carrier is the image closed under the equivalence.<br>描述在相同之下承载规律，恰当描述上有一个等价关系只联系实现同样主张的描述，并以一个动作把描述被它联系的配置带到描述被它联系的配置；承载者是在该等价下闭合的像。 (`Becoming.Registers`, `Becoming.GoAlikeUnder`, `Becoming.imageUnder`, `Becoming.imageUnder_determinedAt`, `Becoming.carries_law_alike_iff`)
7. Where each description is its own claim, the only such equivalence is equality, and this is the law stated with equality; with nothing claimed, every description carries a law.<br>每个描述就是自己的主张时，这样的等价只有相等，这就是以相等陈述的律；什么也不主张时，每个描述都承载规律。 (`Becoming.eq_equivalence`, `Becoming.carries_law_named_iff`, `Becoming.carries_law_iff`, `Becoming.carries_unregistered`)
8. The image is determined up to likeness exactly where configurations whose descriptions are alike in it go alike under it; a description can carry a law up to likeness while its image is not determined up to likeness, so up to likeness the image is no longer the least carrier.<br>像恰在描述在其中相同的配置在其下同行时在相同之下确定；描述可以在相同之下承载规律而它的像在相同之下不确定，所以在相同之下像不再是最小的承载者。 (`Becoming.image_determinedAt_iff`, `Becoming.image_determined_iff`, `Becoming.Image.least`, `Becoming.Parting.image_not_determinedAt`, `Becoming.Parting.carries`)
9. The dichotomy of difference-making needs only that every step by the move from the withheld configuration reaches one level of the condition: then either the part makes the difference or the same move still breaks the dependence; determinacy up to likeness under claims registering that level, and determinacy, are cases.<br>差别制造的二分只需以该动作由扣除后的配置出发的每一步到达条件的同一水平：此时或者那一部分造成差别，或者同一动作仍断裂依存；登记该水平的主张之下的相同之下的确定，以及确定，都是其情形。 (`Becoming.Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level`, `Becoming.Dependence.dichotomy_of_determinedAt`, `Becoming.Dependence.level_registers`, `Becoming.Dependence.dichotomy_of_determined`, `Becoming.Dependence.determined_dichotomy`)
10. Read through a projection, a move not taken at a description alike to the one named is not fixed up to likeness, for outcomes that differ in a claim: so under any process on the descriptions, determined up to likeness, that admits the steps so read, and so wherever some equivalence registering the claims makes configurations go alike.<br>经投影读时，在与所命名者相同的描述处未取的动作，在相同之下不被固定，对在一个主张上不同的结果：在描述上任何相同之下确定、容许如此读的各步的过程之下都是如此，所以凡是有登记主张的等价使配置同行之处都是如此。 (`Becoming.Run.TakesThroughAlike`, `Becoming.Run.FixesThroughAlike`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_untaken`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_goAlikeUnder`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike`)
11. An intervention on one of two alike configurations breaks determinacy up to likeness; a kept history returns up to likeness where its present does and nothing registers the past, so a kept history is new only with its past registered.<br>对相同配置之一的干预破坏相同之下的确定；保留的历史在没有什么登记过去时在相同之下返回，所以保留的历史只在过去被登记时是新的。 (`Becoming.Twins.retarget_breaks`, `Becoming.keepFrame`, `Becoming.keepFrame_alike_iff`, `Becoming.keepHistory_returns_alike`, `Becoming.keepHistory_new_named`)
12. With nothing claimed, no confound is refuted.<br>什么也不主张时，没有混杂被否证。 (`Becoming.Confound.refutes_registered`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No premise: each law states its conditions, among them determinacy up to likeness where it is used and claims that register what is compared; likeness is bisimulation, with no quotient taken.<br>不加前提：每条律写出自己的条件，其中有用到之处的相同之下的确定，以及登记所比较者的主张；相同是互模拟，不取商。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Instances stating that a process is determined are left as they are; Determined.at gives their determinacy up to likeness.<br>陈述某过程确定的实例保持原样；Determined.at 给出它们的相同之下的确定。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Twins.retarget_breaks: retargeting one of two alike twins breaks determinacy up to likeness.<br>Twins.retarget_breaks：对两个相同孪生之一的改送破坏相同之下的确定。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Branching.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Parting: from the start one move leads to a configuration that can go on and to one that cannot; through the identity the image is not determined up to likeness at the start, while with nothing claimed the identity carries a law up to likeness (Parting.image_not_determinedAt, Parting.carries).<br>Parting：起点以同一动作到一个能继续的配置和一个不能继续的配置；经恒等映射，像在起点处在相同之下不确定，而什么也不主张时恒等映射在相同之下承载规律（Parting.image_not_determinedAt、Parting.carries）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Likeness.lean)

## Next / 下一步

Ren's judgment whether the laws that need equality read as depending on what is registered.<br>Ren 的判断：需要相等的律是否读作依赖于所登记的。

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history / 对应、依赖、来源与沿革</summary>

### Correspondence / 对应

Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): likeness is the unfolding's own identity of configurations; the theorems with determinacy that hold up to likeness are about how configurations relate, and those that need equality depend on what is registered: an intervention on one name among alike configurations, a past nothing registers, a description nothing registers. What nothing registers is neither fixed nor refuted (compare the registers of Becoming.Testing). Up to likeness a law is carried by an equivalence that registers the claims, not by the image alone; where each description is its own claim, that equivalence is equality. See §99 of the integration note and its section on Becoming.Likeness.<br>读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：相同是展开自身的配置同一；在相同之下成立的确定定理关乎配置如何相关，需要相等的那些依赖于所登记的：对相同者中一个名字的干预、没有登记的过去、没有登记的描述。没有登记的既不被固定也不被否证（比较 Becoming.Testing 的登记）。在相同之下，承载规律的是一个登记主张的等价，而不只是像：每个描述就是自己的主张时它是相等。见整合文档 §99 与 Becoming.Likeness 一节。
